assessments.reasoning: The two productions distinguish argument-list membership from per-item membership of one enclosed expression. Section 3.1.8 supplies an implicit empty sequence when the curly content is omitted.

challenge.method: Derive member counts for square and curly forms with an explicit empty expression and a multi-item subexpression. Challenge the rule with entirely absent curly content and the empty square argument list.
challenge.results: The square example preserves the empty sequence as one member and the multi-item sequence as one member. The curly example contributes zero and then three members. Empty braces have an implicit empty-sequence operand and produce no members, as does an empty square argument list.

limitations: The source is the exact acquired W3C edition identified by the evidence record. The observed 2021 metadata notice and independently inspected linked context do not supply a different normative edition.
This distinguishes constructor cardinality under successful evaluation. It does not cover node copying, lookup, atomization or runtime implementation.
